self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Aegis of Abyssal Fire, first ATK proc: after the wielder's Elemental Skill hits an opponent, ATK +20% (R1) for 8s. Triggers off-field too. Independent of the take-DMG proc below - a rotation may land one, the other, or both, so they are separate toggles rather than one combined +40% (which is what this entry used to be, forcing both on together). ATK% by refinement: 20/25/30/35/40.

Aegis of Abyssal Fire, second ATK proc: after the wielder takes DMG, ATK +20% (R1) for 8s. Triggers off-field too. Stacks additively with the Elemental Skill proc above; enable both to model the old combined +40%. ATK% by refinement: 20/25/30/35/40.

Aegis of Abyssal Fire, Max HP term: while the wielder is NOT protected by a shield, Max HP +32% (R1). Conditional, not unconditional: a team running Zhongli, Layla, Xinyan or any other shielder turns it off, and it matters most for HP-scaling wielders like Dehya. This was previously an unconditional self modifier fixed at 32%, so it applied even behind a shield AND never moved with refinement. Max HP% by refinement: 32/40/48/56/64.
